title: RDC Operator Kit observation evidence research

scope.paper_reading: Targeted abstracts, relevant sections and appendices; not a claim of complete paper reading

titles: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human

access_attempts.reason: MCP tools require a paid Scite plan or active free trial.
access_attempts.followup: Used accessible primary arXiv pages and official project/code documentation. Did not change account, subscription or collections.
Retrieved arXiv abstract (current v2) and author project page; did not infer inaccessible full-text details.

sources.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
sources.supports: Screenshot and accessibility observations, execution-based evaluation and window perturbation analysis.
sources.does_not_establish: This machine's screenshot origin, latency, or correctness.

sources.title: Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
sources.supports: Observation-action loop and independent final-state evaluation; OS processes run asynchronously.
sources.does_not_establish: Per-action observation freshness or real-time service guarantees.

sources.title: Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human
sources.supports: Bounded action primitives, visual and accessibility inputs, wait action, self-evaluation without external ground truth.
sources.does_not_establish: That self-evaluation is an independent operational oracle.

sources.title: ScreenSpot-Pro: GUI Grounding for Professional High-Resolution Computer Use
sources.supports: Static instruction-screenshot target localization and high-resolution small-target difficulties.
sources.does_not_establish: Freshness at action execution, end-to-end task completion, or this host's GUI accuracy.

sources.title: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
read_scope: Project challenge definitions for dynamic environment and streaming interaction
sources.supports: Distinguishes incoming task changes from visual changes between observation and action.
sources.does_not_establish: Full-text implementation details; current kit performance; availability of a real-time capture channel.

claim_boundaries: Research does not prove actual backend selection for the installed binary on a particular capture.
Rejecting a composite after capture does not undo file creation or guarantee no additional pixels were captured.
Previously viewed smoke02 remains a historical positive example; this branch has not re-audited its raw pixels or raw upstream JSON.
Frame IDs, hashes and call timestamps do not prove compositor frame time or application effect.
Proposed Windows and Linux tests are plans, not reported executions.
